controls.name: cypher-skips-model
controls.find: pub open spec fn cypher_accepts(p:Proc,o:Opt,v:Val)->bool {listed(p,o) && cypher_direction_ok(o,v) && model_ok(o,v)}
controls.replace: pub open spec fn cypher_accepts(p:Proc,o:Opt,v:Val)->bool {listed(p,o) && cypher_direction_ok(o,v)}
controls.classification: decision: the Cypher map read without the method's model (before 4.6.5)

controls.name: keyword-differs
controls.replace: pub open spec fn keyword(p:Proc,o:Opt)->bool {listed(p,o) && o!=Opt::MemBudget}
controls.classification: correspondence: the procedure lists an option the method does not take
